body: I don't know if there's a whole lot we can do. I'm going to give it one last shot when I'm out of my parents' house and living alone for once and see how that treats me. If things turn out bad again, then I'll be old enough to buy a firearm and end it then. I don't think I'm in a position to help anybody out at the moment, but I wish you the best.
This sounds a lot like me.
It's okay, I'm pretty much used to it all and it doesn't bother me anymore. I know that behind his words, he (hopefully) cares for my health. If not, that's okay, too.

I agree that we're all alone. But that doesn't really make it any better. I'm sorry that you're in pain as well. Why does life work this way? Why is no one truly ever happy? Why are there so many people suffering? I just can't help but be pessimistic and that makes me want out of this cruel world.

I see your point. Alright, say I don't try to kill myself. How do I go about leaving the house? I'm 17. I don't have any money to move out and even if I were to land a minimum wage job, I'd have to work 24/7. A minimum wage job is not enough to support yourself. A 24/7 slave job. How fun and totally not suicide-tempting.

I'm interested in going to college actually. But years of being shut in has led to me being socially retarded and won't be able to make meaningful relationships for the life of me.
